verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֬חַ עַֽל־ שׁוֹשַׁנִּ֬ים לְדָוִֽד׃ הוֹשִׁיעֵ֥נִי אֱלֹהִ֑ים כִּ֤י בָ֖אוּ מַ֣יִם עַד־ נָֽפֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ ‘al- šō·wō·šan·nîm lə·ḏā·wiḏ hō·wō·šî·‘ê·nî ’ĕ·lō·hîm kî ḇā·’ū ma·yim ‘aḏ- nā·p̄eš
verses.literal: For the choirmaster To the tune of Lilies Of David Save me O God for the waters are up to my neck

verses.original: טָבַ֤עְתִּי׀ בִּיוֵ֣ן מְ֭צוּלָה וְאֵ֣ין מָעֳמָ֑ד בָּ֥אתִי בְמַעֲמַקֵּי־ מַ֝֗יִם וְשִׁבֹּ֥לֶת שְׁטָפָֽתְנִי׃
verses.transliteration: ṭā·ḇa‘·tî bî·wên mə·ṣū·lāh wə·’ên mā·‘o·māḏ bā·ṯî ḇə·ma·‘ă·maq·qê- ma·yim wə·šib·bō·leṯ šə·ṭā·p̄ā·ṯə·nî
verses.literal: I have sunk into the miry depths where there is no footing I have drifted into deep waters where the flood engulfs me

verses.original: יָגַ֣עְתִּי בְקָרְאִי֮ נִחַ֪ר גְּר֫וֹנִ֥י כָּל֥וּ עֵינַ֑י מְ֝יַחֵ֗ל לֵאלֹהָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: yā·ḡa‘·tî ḇə·qā·rə·’î ni·ḥar gə·rō·w·nî kā·lū ‘ê·nay mə·ya·ḥêl lê·lō·hāy
verses.literal: I am weary from my crying my throat is parched My eyes fail looking for my God

verses.original: רַבּ֤וּ׀ מִשַּׂעֲר֣וֹת רֹאשִׁי֮ שֹׂנְאַ֪י חִ֫נָּ֥ם עָצְמ֣וּ מַ֭צְמִיתַי אֹיְבַ֣י שֶׁ֑קֶר אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־ גָ֝זַ֗לְתִּי אָ֣ז אָשִֽׁיב׃
verses.transliteration: rab·bū miś·śa·‘ă·rō·wṯ rō·šî śō·nə·’ay ḥin·nām ‘ā·ṣə·mū maṣ·mî·ṯay ’ō·yə·ḇay še·qer ’ă·šer lō- ḡā·zal·tî ’āz ’ā·šîḇ
verses.literal: Those who hate me without cause outnumber the hairs of my head many are those who would destroy me my enemies for no reason Though I did not steal . . . I must repay

verses.original: אֱ‍ֽלֹהִ֗ים אַתָּ֣ה יָ֭דַעְתָּ לְאִוַּלְתִּ֑י וְ֝אַשְׁמוֹתַ֗י מִמְּךָ֥ לֹא־ נִכְחָֽדוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕlō·hîm ’at·tāh yā·ḏa‘·tā lə·’iw·wal·tî wə·’aš·mō·w·ṯay mim·mə·ḵā lō- niḵ·ḥā·ḏū
verses.literal: You know my folly O God and my guilt is not hidden from You

verses.original: אַל־ יֵ֘בֹ֤שׁוּ בִ֨י׀ קֹוֶיךָ֮ אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִ֗ה צְבָ֫א֥וֹת אַל־ יִכָּ֣לְמוּ בִ֣י מְבַקְשֶׁ֑יךָ אֱ֝לֹהֵ֗י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- yê·ḇō·šū ḇî qō·we·ḵā ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’al- yik·kā·lə·mū ḇî mə·ḇaq·še·ḵā ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: May those who hope in You not be ashamed through me O Lord GOD of Hosts may those who seek You not be dishonored through me O God of Israel

verses.original: כִּֽי־ עָ֭לֶיךָ נָשָׂ֣אתִי חֶרְפָּ֑ה כִּסְּתָ֖ה כְלִמָּ֣ה פָנָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ‘ā·le·ḵā nā·śā·ṯî ḥer·pāh kis·sə·ṯāh ḵə·lim·māh p̄ā·nāy
verses.literal: For I have endured scorn for Your sake and shame has covered my face

verses.original: מ֭וּזָר הָיִ֣יתִי לְאֶחָ֑י וְ֝נָכְרִ֗י לִבְנֵ֥י אִמִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: mū·zār hā·yî·ṯî lə·’e·ḥāy wə·nā·ḵə·rî liḇ·nê ’im·mî
verses.literal: I have become a stranger to my brothers and a foreigner to my mother’s sons

verses.original: כִּֽי־ קִנְאַ֣ת בֵּיתְךָ֣ אֲכָלָ֑תְנִי וְחֶרְפּ֥וֹת ח֝וֹרְפֶ֗יךָ נָפְל֥וּ עָלָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kî- qin·’aṯ bê·ṯə·ḵā ’ă·ḵā·lā·ṯə·nî wə·ḥer·pō·wṯ ḥō·wr·p̄e·ḵā nā·p̄ə·lū ‘ā·lāy
verses.literal: because zeal for Your house has consumed me and the insults of those who insult You have fallen on me

verses.original: וָאֶבְכֶּ֣ה בַצּ֣וֹם נַפְשִׁ֑י וַתְּהִ֖י לַחֲרָפ֣וֹת לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’eḇ·keh ḇaṣ·ṣō·wm nap̄·šî wat·tə·hî la·ḥă·rā·p̄ō·wṯ lî
verses.literal: I wept and fasted but it brought me reproach

verses.original: וָאֶתְּנָ֣ה לְבוּשִׁ֣י שָׂ֑ק וָאֱהִ֖י לָהֶ֣ם לְמָשָֽׁל׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’et·tə·nāh lə·ḇū·šî śāq wā·’ĕ·hî lā·hem lə·mā·šāl
verses.literal: I made sackcloth my clothing and I was sport to them

verses.original: יָשִׂ֣יחוּ בִ֭י יֹ֣שְׁבֵי שָׁ֑עַר וּ֝נְגִינ֗וֹת שׁוֹתֵ֥י שֵׁכָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: yā·śî·ḥū ḇî yō·šə·ḇê šā·‘ar ū·nə·ḡî·nō·wṯ šō·w·ṯê šê·ḵār
verses.literal: Those who sit at the gate mock me and I am the song of drunkards . . .

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֤י תְפִלָּתִֽי־ לְךָ֨׀ יְהוָ֡ה עֵ֤ת רָצ֗וֹן אֱלֹהִ֥ים בְּרָב־ חַסְדֶּ֑ךָ עֲ֝נֵ֗נִי בֶּאֱמֶ֥ת יִשְׁעֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî ṯə·p̄il·lā·ṯî- lə·ḵā Yah·weh ‘êṯ rā·ṣō·wn ’ĕ·lō·hîm bə·rāḇ- ḥas·de·ḵā ‘ă·nê·nî be·’ĕ·meṯ yiš·‘e·ḵā
verses.literal: But my prayer to You O LORD is for a time of favor In Your abundant loving devotion O God answer me with Your sure salvation

verses.original: הַצִּילֵ֣נִי מִ֭טִּיט וְאַל־ אֶטְבָּ֑עָה אִנָּצְלָ֥ה מִ֝שֹּֽׂנְאַ֗י וּמִמַּֽעֲמַקֵּי־ מָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: haṣ·ṣî·lê·nî miṭ·ṭîṭ wə·’al- ’eṭ·bā·‘āh ’in·nā·ṣə·lāh miś·śō·nə·’ay ū·mim·ma·‘ă·maq·qê- mā·yim
verses.literal: Rescue me from the mire and do not let me sink deliver me from my foes and out of the deep waters

verses.original: אַל־ תִּשְׁטְפֵ֤נִי׀ שִׁבֹּ֣לֶת מַ֭יִם וְאַל־ תִּבְלָעֵ֣נִי מְצוּלָ֑ה וְאַל־ תֶּאְטַר־ עָלַ֖י בְּאֵ֣ר פִּֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tiš·ṭə·p̄ê·nî šib·bō·leṯ ma·yim wə·’al- tiḇ·lā·‘ê·nî mə·ṣū·lāh wə·’al- te’·ṭar- ‘ā·lay bə·’êr pî·hā
verses.literal: Do not let the floods . . . engulf me or the depths . . . swallow me up let not the Pit close its mouth over me

verses.original: עֲנֵ֣נִי יְ֭הוָה כִּי־ ט֣וֹב חַסְדֶּ֑ךָ כְּרֹ֥ב רַ֝חֲמֶ֗יךָ פְּנֵ֣ה אֵלָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ă·nê·nî Yah·weh kî- ṭō·wḇ ḥas·de·ḵā kə·rōḇ ra·ḥă·me·ḵā pə·nêh ’ê·lāy
verses.literal: Answer me O LORD for Your loving devotion is good turn to me in keeping with Your great compassion

verses.original: וְאַל־ תַּסְתֵּ֣ר פָּ֭נֶיךָ מֵֽעַבְדֶּ֑ךָ כִּֽי־ צַר־ לִ֝֗י מַהֵ֥ר עֲנֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’al- tas·têr pā·ne·ḵā mê·‘aḇ·de·ḵā kî- ṣar- lî ma·hêr ‘ă·nê·nî
verses.literal: Hide not Your face from Your servant for I am in distress Answer me quickly

verses.original: קָרְבָ֣ה אֶל־ נַפְשִׁ֣י גְאָלָ֑הּ לְמַ֖עַן אֹיְבַ֣י פְּדֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: qā·rə·ḇāh ’el- nap̄·šî ḡə·’ā·lāh lə·ma·‘an ’ō·yə·ḇay pə·ḏê·nî
verses.literal: Draw near to my soul and redeem me ransom me because of my foes

verses.original: אַתָּ֤ה יָדַ֗עְתָּ חֶרְפָּתִ֣י וּ֭בָשְׁתִּי וּכְלִמָּתִ֑י נֶ֝גְדְּךָ֗ כָּל־ צוֹרְרָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’at·tāh yā·ḏa‘·tā ḥer·pā·ṯî ū·ḇā·šə·tî ū·ḵə·lim·mā·ṯî neḡ·də·ḵā kāl- ṣō·wr·rāy
verses.literal: You know my reproach my shame and disgrace All my adversaries are before You

verses.original: חֶרְפָּ֤ה׀ שָֽׁבְרָ֥ה לִבִּ֗י וָֽאָ֫נ֥וּשָׁה וָאֲקַוֶּ֣ה לָנ֣וּד וָאַ֑יִן וְ֝לַמְנַחֲמִ֗ים וְלֹ֣א מָצָֽאתִי׃
verses.transliteration: ḥer·pāh šā·ḇə·rāh lib·bî wā·’ā·nū·šāh wā·’ă·qaw·weh lā·nūḏ wā·’a·yin wə·lam·na·ḥă·mîm wə·lō mā·ṣā·ṯî
verses.literal: Insults have broken my heart and I am in despair I looked for sympathy but there was none for comforters but I found no one

verses.original: וַיִּתְּנ֣וּ בְּבָרוּתִ֣י רֹ֑אשׁ וְ֝לִצְמָאִ֗י יַשְׁק֥וּנִי חֹֽמֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tə·nū bə·ḇā·rū·ṯî rōš wə·liṣ·mā·’î yaš·qū·nî ḥō·meṣ
verses.literal: They poisoned my food with gall and gave me vinegar to quench my thirst

verses.original: יְהִֽי־ שֻׁלְחָנָ֣ם לִפְנֵיהֶ֣ם לְפָ֑ח וְלִשְׁלוֹמִ֥ים לְמוֹקֵֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: yə·hî- šul·ḥā·nām lip̄·nê·hem lə·p̄āḥ wə·liš·lō·w·mîm lə·mō·w·qêš
verses.literal: May their table . . . become a snare may it be a retribution and a trap

verses.original: תֶּחְשַׁ֣כְנָה עֵ֭ינֵיהֶם מֵרְא֑וֹת וּ֝מָתְנֵ֗יהֶם תָּמִ֥יד הַמְעַֽד׃
verses.transliteration: teḥ·šaḵ·nāh ‘ê·nê·hem mê·rə·’ō·wṯ ū·mā·ṯə·nê·hem tā·mîḏ ham·‘aḏ
verses.literal: May their eyes be darkened so they cannot see and their backs be bent forever

verses.original: שְׁפָךְ־ עֲלֵיהֶ֥ם זַעְמֶ֑ךָ וַחֲר֥וֹן אַ֝פְּךָ֗ יַשִּׂיגֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: šə·p̄āḵ- ‘ă·lê·hem za‘·me·ḵā wa·ḥă·rō·wn ’ap·pə·ḵā yaś·śî·ḡêm
verses.literal: Pour out Your wrath upon them and let Your burning anger . . . overtake them

verses.original: תְּהִי־ טִֽירָתָ֥ם נְשַׁמָּ֑ה בְּ֝אָהֳלֵיהֶ֗ם אַל־ יְהִ֥י יֹשֵֽׁב׃
verses.transliteration: tə·hî- ṭî·rā·ṯām nə·šam·māh bə·’ā·ho·lê·hem ’al- yə·hî yō·šêḇ
verses.literal: May their place be deserted let there be no one to dwell in their tents

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אַתָּ֣ה אֲשֶׁר־ הִכִּ֣יתָ רָדָ֑פוּ וְאֶל־ מַכְא֖וֹב חֲלָלֶ֣יךָ יְסַפֵּֽרוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ’at·tāh ’ă·šer- hik·kî·ṯā rā·ḏā·p̄ū wə·’el- maḵ·’ō·wḇ ḥă·lā·le·ḵā yə·sap·pê·rū
verses.literal: For they persecute the one You struck and recount . . . the pain of those You wounded

verses.original: תְּֽנָה־ עָ֭וֺן עַל־ עֲוֺנָ֑ם וְאַל־ יָ֝בֹ֗אוּ בְּצִדְקָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: tə·nāh- ‘ā·wōn ‘al- ‘ă·wō·nām wə·’al- yā·ḇō·’ū bə·ṣiḏ·qā·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: Add iniquity to their iniquity let them not share in Your righteousness

verses.original: יִ֭מָּחֽוּ מִסֵּ֣פֶר חַיִּ֑ים וְעִ֥ם צַ֝דִּיקִ֗ים אַל־ יִכָּתֵֽבוּ׃
verses.transliteration: yim·mā·ḥū mis·sê·p̄er ḥay·yîm wə·‘im ṣad·dî·qîm ’al- yik·kā·ṯê·ḇū
verses.literal: May they be blotted out of the Book of Life and not listed with the righteous

verses.original: וַ֭אֲנִי עָנִ֣י וְכוֹאֵ֑ב יְשׁוּעָתְךָ֖ אֱלֹהִ֣ים תְּשַׂגְּבֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî ‘ā·nî wə·ḵō·w·’êḇ yə·šū·‘ā·ṯə·ḵā ’ĕ·lō·hîm tə·śag·gə·ḇê·nî
verses.literal: But I am in pain and distress let Your salvation protect me O God

verses.original: אֲהַֽלְלָ֣ה שֵׁם־ אֱלֹהִ֣ים בְּשִׁ֑יר וַאֲגַדְּלֶ֥נּוּ בְתוֹדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·hal·lāh šêm- ’ĕ·lō·hîm bə·šîr wa·’ă·ḡad·də·len·nū ḇə·ṯō·w·ḏāh
verses.literal: I will praise God’s name in song and exalt Him with thanksgiving

verses.original: וְתִיטַ֣ב לַֽ֭יהוָה מִשּׁ֥וֹר פָּ֗ר מַקְרִ֥ן מַפְרִֽיס׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ṯî·ṭaḇ Yah·weh miš·šō·wr pār maq·rin map̄·rîs
verses.literal: And this will please the LORD more than an ox more than a bull with horns and hooves

verses.original: רָא֣וּ עֲנָוִ֣ים יִשְׂמָ֑חוּ דֹּרְשֵׁ֥י אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים וִיחִ֥י לְבַבְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: rā·’ū ‘ă·nā·wîm yiś·mā·ḥū dō·rə·šê ’ĕ·lō·hîm wî·ḥî lə·ḇaḇ·ḵem
verses.literal: The humble will see and rejoice You who seek God let your hearts be revived

verses.original: כִּֽי־ שֹׁמֵ֣עַ אֶל־ אֶבְיוֹנִ֣ים יְהוָ֑ה וְאֶת־ אֲ֝סִירָ֗יו לֹ֣א בָזָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî- šō·mê·a‘ ’el- ’eḇ·yō·w·nîm Yah·weh wə·’eṯ- ’ă·sî·rāw lō ḇā·zāh
verses.literal: For the LORD listens to the needy and does not despise His captive people

verses.original: יְֽ֭הַלְלוּהוּ שָׁמַ֣יִם וָאָ֑רֶץ יַ֝מִּ֗ים וְֽכָל־ רֹמֵ֥שׂ בָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: yə·hal·lū·hū šā·ma·yim wā·’ā·reṣ yam·mîm wə·ḵāl rō·mêś bām
verses.literal: Let heaven and earth praise Him the seas and everything that moves in them

verses.original: כִּ֤י אֱלֹהִ֨ים׀ י֘וֹשִׁ֤יעַ צִיּ֗וֹן וְ֭יִבְנֶה עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה וְיָ֥שְׁבוּ שָׁ֝֗ם וִירֵשֽׁוּהָ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’ĕ·lō·hîm yō·wō·šî·a‘ ṣî·yō·wn wə·yiḇ·neh ‘ā·rê yə·hū·ḏāh wə·yā·šə·ḇū šām wî·rê·šū·hā
verses.literal: For God will save Zion and rebuild the cities of Judah that they may dwell there and possess it

verses.original: וְזֶ֣רַע עֲ֭בָדָיו יִנְחָל֑וּהָ וְאֹהֲבֵ֥י שְׁ֝מ֗וֹ יִשְׁכְּנוּ־ בָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ze·ra‘ ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw yin·ḥā·lū·hā wə·’ō·hă·ḇê šə·mô yiš·kə·nū- ḇāh
verses.literal: The descendants of His servants will inherit it and those who love His name will settle in it
